reason: My clients already order on WhatsApp and pay by mobile money, and I send the PDF myself. With Maketia I would still confirm each payment by hand and send the link, plus open a SasPay account and learn an editor, so for me it is more work, not less.
objection: I'm not comfortable with technical tools, and I don't see what I gain if I still have to confirm every payment and send the link manually like I do now.
would_change_my_mind: Automatic payment confirmation with the file delivered to the buyer without me, plus someone who sets up my first page with me in French on WhatsApp.
